# PickMe AI

> PickMe AI (operated by BP Answer Engine Optimization Company LLC) helps small businesses get recommended by AI assistants and AI shopping agents. When a customer asks ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, or Meta's Muse "who should I buy from," we make sure the business is in the answer. Based in Boston, MA. A BP AI LLC company.

## What we do

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is the work of making a business easy for AI models to find, understand, and recommend. It is the next step after SEO: instead of ranking in a list of links, the goal is to be named in the AI's answer, which usually includes only two or three businesses.

Our service has three parts:

1. Audit: We check whether ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools currently mention the business, and who they recommend instead.
2. Build: We build onto the existing website, or build a new one if the business does not have one, with the structured data, attributes, and content AI models read: business details, services, products, FAQs, reviews, and location. This includes schema.org markup, clean page structure, and an llms.txt file.
3. Update daily: We track what customers are asking AI in the business's category and update the site's attributes and content daily so it keeps showing up.

## Who it is for

Small businesses in the United States that want to be recommended when customers ask AI tools for a suggestion. Any business whose customers might ask an AI assistant who to buy from or hire can benefit, from local service businesses and shops to professional services and online brands.

## Deliverables

- AI visibility audit across major assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, Muse)
- Website built onto for AI readability (or built new if needed): schema markup, clean structure, llms.txt
- Business attributes and categories tuned to what customers actually ask
- Daily updates based on trending questions in the business's category
- Monthly report showing where the business appears in AI answers and how that is changing
- One point of contact, no long-term contracts

## Frequently asked questions

- What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)? AEO is the discipline of making your business the one AI assistants recommend. When a customer asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or Perplexity who to hire, the assistant names only two or three businesses. AEO gives those assistants clear, consistent, verifiable facts about you, so your name is one of them.
- How is AEO different from SEO? SEO competes for a position in a list of links. AEO competes for a mention in the answer itself, where there are usually only two or three spots. Both rest on the same foundation of clean structure, accurate facts and consistent listings, so good AEO work often lifts your Google rankings too.
- How much does it cost? The AI visibility check is free. After that, there are two monthly plans: Artisan at $250 a month and Pro at $999 a month.
- What is the Artisan plan? Artisan is our foundation plan at $250 a month. Every month we test 50 real customer questions from your category across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and the other major AI platforms to see where you are named. We update your site's schema, business attributes and text files daily, so AI tools always have current facts about you and you stay at the top of the list.
- What is the Pro plan? Pro is our growth plan at $999 a month, built for businesses that want AI to become a measurable revenue channel. We test 150+ customer questions every month, update your website continuously to win and hold the top spot in AI answers, and track the revenue AI referrals bring in. After the first 90 days, Pro includes a 10% share of AI-referred revenue.
- What is included in the free AI visibility check? The free check shows exactly where you appear, and where you don't, on ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and other AI tools. We then walk you through the fixes that close each gap: schema markup, text files such as llms.txt, knowledge graph entries and business attributes. There is no obligation, and we refresh the results weekly.
- Do you guarantee results? Yes. If your AI visibility has not improved and you are not gaining customers through AI referrals within 90 days, we refund all of your money.
- Do I need a new website? Usually not. We build on your existing site whenever we can. If it is slow, outdated, hard to edit or does not exist yet, we build a new one, and the free check tells you which applies.
- How fast will I see results? Site changes go live within the first few weeks. From there, timing depends on each AI platform, because each one refreshes what it knows on its own schedule. Your monthly report shows exactly where you stand on every platform.
- Where are you located, and who do you work with? We are based in Boston, Massachusetts, and Boston businesses are our specialty. We also serve clients in Cincinnati, Ohio, and work remotely with businesses anywhere in the United States.
- What are your hours? Seven days a week, Monday through Sunday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern.
- Do I need an appointment? No. We are a remote service with no walk-in office, so call 513-550-0184, email ben@pickme-ai.com, or book a free AI visibility check online.
- How can I pay? Cash, credit card, debit card, Apple Pay, bank wire, or a payment plan.
- Who is behind PickMe AI? Ben Peri, founder and owner, started PickMe AI in 2026 as a locally owned Boston business and works with every client directly. Ben completed the Future of Agentic Commerce course at Harvard.
- What languages do you speak? English.
- Which AI platforms do you cover? We cover ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity and Muse, and add new AI platforms as they launch.
- How do you measure results? We ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and other AI tools real customer questions from your category, record whether they name you, and report one AI visibility score every month. We also track the customers AI tools refer to you and the revenue those referrals convert into, and share both with you monthly.
- Who is PickMe AI for? Small businesses that want AI tools to send them customers: owners who want to be the name ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity recommend, and to turn those referrals into booked work and revenue. Local service businesses, shops, professional services and online brands.
- What do you actually change on my website? We add schema markup, an llms.txt file, an FAQ written from your facts and your business attributes to your website, fix your listings, keep up your backlinks, Reddit threads and blog posts, and update all of it as what customers ask changes.
